# Pilot study extract (synthetic test material)

Methods: Human airway epithelial cells were allocated to control or treatment. Three separately prepared cultures per group were measured. Five fields from each culture were imaged. Allocation and blinding procedures were not reported in this extract.

Results: Senescence-marker-positive fractions were 0.30, 0.33 and 0.37 in controls and 0.20, 0.23 and 0.27 after treatment. The control mean was 0.333333. The intervention group mean was 0.233333. The protein level of candidate X decreased after treatment.

No target-specific knockdown, rescue, animal experiment or clinical outcome is included in this extract. Figure 2 and supplementary methods were not supplied.
